title: Working for the Tuxedo owner at the Doghouse, with Crosby and Bill Matthews
summary: He worked later for the club owner at the Doghouse and Paddock. He says there was always plenty of work in New Orleans, and musicians could quit and pick jobs.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
